description: 17 nálezů z čtvrtého kola hloubkového auditu (commit 2176b0e, 2026-11-08). Pokrývá: EvidenceStore source integrity, worktree locking, TransactionStashHook ownership, LearningStore state machine, AgentConsistencyGuard, work fencing contention, snapshot I/O, model quality receipts, lint completeness a audit contracts.

task_t01_evidence_integrity.description: put(): ověřit text vůči obsahu souboru na deklarovaném rozsahu řádků; odmítnout absolutní cesty a úniky mimo root. validate_current(): přidat path.relative_to(root). Přidat pole source_verified. AC: záznam se správným hash+chybným textem nikdy nezíská source_verified=True. Priority: critical.
task_t01_evidence_integrity.next_action: Focused source-path race and provenance tests pass. Windows symlink test is skipped because symlink creation is unavailable on this host; retain this platform limitation in final acceptance. No broad suite or live runtime acceptance yet.
task_t01_evidence_integrity.title: A01+A17 — EvidenceStore: source_verified a path confinement

task_t02_evidence_hash_streaming.description: Nahradit path.read_bytes() za blokové čtení 1 MiB chunks. Přidat explicitní limit velikosti souboru. Ověřit identitu souboru před a po čtení. Priority: high.
task_t02_evidence_hash_streaming.next_action: Implemented 1 MiB streaming, shared 4 MiB bound, regular-file check, and before/after file identity validation. Boundary test verifies exact limit succeeds and limit+1 is rejected. Focused evidence tests: 12 passed, 1 skipped (host symlink support unavailable).
task_t02_evidence_hash_streaming.title: A02 — EvidenceStore: inkrementální hashování souborů

task_t03_worktree_locking.description: get_worktree_status(): spouštět 'git worktree list' nad samotným worktree, ne nad target.parent. Vracet 'unknown' místo tichého 'unlocked'. unlock_worktree fallback: nepoužívat basename; ověřit skutečná Git worktree metadata. Při nejednoznačnosti odmítnout ruční unlock. Priority: critical.
task_t03_worktree_locking.next_action: Implemented unknown lock status, target-worktree lock query, exact Git metadata validation for fallback and zombie unlock. Focused tests: tests/unit/test_worktrees_extended.py + tests/unit/test_worktree_lock_cleanup.py, 10 passed. Affected paths src/local_ai_hub/worktrees.py and tests/unit/test_worktrees_extended.py. Broader suite remains deferred.
task_t03_worktree_locking.title: A03+A04 — Worktrees: zjišťování a ruční odemykání zámků

task_t04_stash_ownership.description: restore() a drop() musí používat uloženou _stash_sha pro identifikaci. Ověřit commit před mutací. Odmítnout tiché stash@{0}. Pokud vlastní stash nelze bezpečně identifikovat, selhat bez mutace cizího stashe. Priority: critical.
task_t04_stash_ownership.next_action: Implemented exact recorded SHA matching and pre-mutation commit verification with bounded ref re-resolution. Race regressions insert a foreign stash between lookup and verification; restore/drop retain it and act on the owned stash. Focused test: tests/unit/test_transaction_stash_restore_hook.py, 10 passed. Source SHA-256 ae3c69b965060adefefda918431c9fb0a9aa2fde4a5ca364e0d10befc8d3bba5. Current HEAD 5131e2b1f4658887e44c12ea15ed2c23e98e3d17.
task_t04_stash_ownership.title: A05 — TransactionStashHook: identita vlastního stashe

acceptance_criteria: Povolit pouze explicitní následné přechody CANDIDATE→REPLAY_PASSED→SHADOW_PASSED→CANARY_PASSED→APPROVED; odmítnout neenum, přeskočené i zpětné přechody a terminální stavy.
advance() nikdy nesmí nastavit PROMOTED.
PROMOTED vzniká pouze po validaci autoritativního approval receipt, svázaného s kandidátem a schválenou akcí; approver text sám nestačí.
task_t05_learning_state_machine.blocker: The local state-machine portion is focused-verified at source SHA 3ee91a1273e6de15b0518460652e700af9b4eac434d7c4eb2e8c0f9a61eb34a1; `python -m pytest -q tests/test_agent_learning.py -k advance --tb=short` passed 9 tests (17 deselected). Promotion remains fail-closed: no authoritative candidate/action-bound approval receipt issuer is established, and app.py is Laya-owned with no writer handoff. Thus acceptance requiring actual receipt verification and app-path behavior remains OPEN; no integration or runtime claim.
task_t05_learning_state_machine.description: Implementovat validační funkci pro všechny přechody CandidateStatus. advance() odmítnout přímý přechod do PROMOTED. Stav PROMOTED smí vzniknout pouze přes schválenou promotion transakci s autoritativním approval receipt. Priority: critical.
task_t05_learning_state_machine.next_action: Keep promotion fail-closed. Obtain explicit app.py writer handoff and evidence of the authoritative candidate/action-bound receipt issuer. Then wire only that verifier and run focused valid/invalid app-path receipt tests; otherwise leave integration open.
task_t05_learning_state_machine.title: A06 — LearningStore: vynucené stavové přechody

acceptance_criteria: Learning event append and candidate projection write use the same SQLite connection and transaction.
A repeated identical transition is idempotent and does not create a second logical event.
Injected failures before/after event append and before/after projection leave both event and projection unchanged.
task_t06_learning_atomicity.description: Ukládat event a projekci v jedné SQLite transakci pomocí append_in_transaction(). Implementovat idempotenci opakovaného přechodu. Testovat selhání před/po eventu a před/po projekci. Priority: high.
task_t06_learning_atomicity.next_action: Event append plus learning projection now share one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction via append_in_transaction(strict_idempotency=True). Create, advance, promote, and rollback use the atomic helper; duplicate transition retry returns existing projection. Four injected failure points (before/after event and before/after projection) roll back both. Focused validation: 27 passed, 15 deselected across learning, storage reliability, and audit regression selections; git diff --check clean. Broad suite and live runtime remain unverified.
task_t06_learning_atomicity.title: A07 — LearningStore: atomický zápis event+projekce

acceptance_criteria: SLO success-rate evaluation uses a bounded count or time window, not lifetime cumulative counters.
Persist success_count and failure_count for the active window and honor min_samples.
Rollback only after min_samples and when aggregate window success rate is below min_success_rate.
task_t07_slo_success_rate.description: Zavést časové nebo počtové okno s agregací success_count, failure_count, min_sample_count. Rollback pouze při překročení agregovaného failure rate. Priority: high.
task_t07_slo_success_rate.next_action: Added bounded rolling success window (window_size up to 64), persisted window count/success/failure counts and exact bit history in numeric metrics. min_samples gates aggregate success-rate rollback; observation success also requires zero error_count. Regression verifies rolling failures override earlier successes and verifies persisted counts. Focused validation: 29 passed, 15 deselected across learning/storage/audit selections; git diff --check clean. Broad suite and live runtime remain unverified.
task_t07_slo_success_rate.title: A08 — LearningStore: SLO min_success_rate jako agregace

acceptance_criteria: Backend/frontend file pairs require concrete API evidence: method+endpoint, OpenAPI operation ID, DTO type, or explicit import.
Pairs without concrete evidence return insufficient_evidence and are not emitted as mappings.
TypeScript backend files are not misclassified as frontend solely by extension.
task_t08_contract_mapping.description: build_contract_mappings(): vyžadovat konkrétní API vazbu (HTTP method+endpoint, OpenAPI op ID, DTO typ, explicitní import). Bez vazby vrátit insufficient_evidence. Opravit _is_frontend() pro TypeScript backend. Priority: high.
task_t08_contract_mapping.next_action: Contract mappings now require a shared method+endpoint, operationId, DTO declaration/reference, or explicit frontend import of the backend module. Unlinked frontend/backend candidates produce an insufficient_evidence warning; basename similarity is ignored. TypeScript under backend/server/API path markers is not treated as frontend. Focused regressions: seven A09 cases passed; combined A06-A09 selection: 36 passed, 14 deselected; git diff --check clean. Broad suite and live runtime remain unverified.
task_t08_contract_mapping.title: A09 — ConsistencyGuard: párování backend/frontend kontraktů

acceptance_criteria: check_drift receives and reuses already-computed candidates instead of searching again.
When git diff is unavailable or fails, return analysis_status='unavailable' or 'partial' with the failure represented; do not imply complete analysis.
task_t09_guard_reuse.description: Předávat vypočtené candidates do check_drift() jako vstup místo opakovaného vyhledávání. Vracet analysis_status=unavailable|partial při neúspěchu diffu. Priority: medium.
task_t09_guard_reuse.next_action: check_drift now accepts reuse_candidates and uses supplied candidates, avoiding a second search from LocalAIServices. Diff analysis status is complete/partial/unavailable; git_diff exceptions and null results become explicit unavailable records, status is returned in both guarded success and stop responses. Focused validation: 93 passed, 1 deselected across agent consistency, service consistency, and audit regressions; deselection is stale A03 T4-04 assertion. git diff --check clean. Broad suite and live runtime remain unverified.
task_t09_guard_reuse.title: A10+A11 — ConsistencyGuard: recyklace reuse candidates a analysis_status

acceptance_criteria: Measure private snapshot cost on NTFS with a representative working tree and record workload and repeatable timings.
Any optimization preserves dirty overlay, path safety, source pre/post comparison and an operator-selectable full-snapshot path.
task_t11_snapshot_optimization.description: Profilovat create_private_transaction_snapshot_with_manifest na NTFS. Zvážit reflink/inkrementální manifest/omezený scope. Zachovat dirty overlay a pre/post image compare. Uživatel musí mít možnost přepnout na plný snapshot. Priority: medium.
task_t11_snapshot_optimization.next_action: Implemented `_copy_tree` destination-manifest hashing and `full_verification` selection through both snapshot helpers; source pre/post manifests, dirty/untracked overlay and path/type/metadata guards retained. Regressions: default path reduces `_tree_manifest` calls from 3 to 2 and verifies byte/metadata parity; `full_verification=True` restores the third destination scan. `python -m pytest -q tests/test_command_transaction_snapshot.py` — 23 passed in 25.35s; scoped `git diff --check` clean. C: NTFS paired benchmark: 250 files × 16 KiB, 25 directories, 276 manifest entries, clean committed tree, 3 alternating pairs. Fast path 1.0707/1.0157/0.9868s (median 1.0157); full-rescan path 1.0881/1.1268/1.1177s (median 1.1177), 1.100×. Current paired comparison shows about 9.1% lower median. Historical 10.0027s baseline has same stated workload but is 8.95× slower than current full-rescan run; retain as environment/run-condition discrepancy, not a direct speedup claim. Broad suite/release checks remain deferred.
task_t11_snapshot_optimization.title: A13 — Transaction snapshot: snížení I/O průchodů

acceptance_criteria: A promotion receipt contains a non-empty model_digest, suite_version, dataset_hash and concrete run_id.
The receipt names a non-empty evaluator_id.
Where candidate metadata declares model_digest, the receipt digest must match it.
A bare evaluation_hash or caller-supplied reproducible=true cannot authorize promotion.
task_t12_quality_receipts.description: promote_candidate() vynutit vazbu na model digest, verzi suite, hash datasetu, konkrétní run s evaluátorem. Odmítnout receipt pouze s neprázdným evaluation_hash. Priority: high.
task_t12_quality_receipts.next_action: A14 strict receipt binding implemented: require receipt_id, model_digest, suite_version, dataset_hash, run_id and evaluator_id; compare receipt model_digest to candidate top-level/metadata digest when supplied; self-asserted reproducible and bare evaluation_hash no longer bypass the gate. Regression covers accepted complete receipt, weak receipts and digest mismatch. Focused validation: py -3.11 -m pytest -q tests/test_model_quality.py tests/unit/test_model_quality_and_probe_edge_cases.py tests/unit/test_model_quality_hardening_wave20.py --tb=short — 16 passed in 0.72s. git diff --check on scoped files exited 0. Broad suite and live runtime not run.
task_t12_quality_receipts.title: A14 — Model quality: silné evaluation receipts

task_t13_lint_completeness.description: submit() vrátit requested_paths_count, accepted_paths_count, truncated, omitted_paths_count. Označit lint výsledek jako partial pokud truncated=True. Priority: medium.
task_t13_lint_completeness.next_action: Implemented requested/accepted/omitted counts and truncation metadata in SpeculativeLintQueue.submit; all supplied paths are validated while preserving the existing caller-order cap selection. Cap metadata persists in the async payload. Completed Ruff/Biome/one-shot service results set partial=true only when capped. Regression coverage verifies capped submission/payload, capped completed service result and input-order selection. Fresh focused validation: py -3.11 -m pytest -q tests/test_speculative_lint.py tests/unit/test_speculative_lint_edge_cases.py --tb=short — 10 passed in 0.71s. git diff --check on scoped files exited 0; LF-to-CRLF warning only for edited test file. Dense indexed diff reviewed; unrelated pre-existing services.py A10/A11 hunks preserved. HEAD 5131e2b1f4658887e44c12ea15ed2c23e98e3d17; shared checkout remains dirty.
task_t13_lint_completeness.title: A15 — SpeculativeLint: explicitní příznak zkrácení

task_t14_audit_contracts.description: completion_audit() vyžadovat passed is True (ne bool('false')=True). Nevalidní typ označit jako invalid_receipt. check_drift() přidat analysis_status. Priority: high.

Focused regressions verify string `"false"` is invalid, missing `passed` is invalid, `True` satisfies, `False` remains unsatisfied. `py -3.11 -m pytest -q tests/test_agent_consistency.py::test_completion_audit_marks_non_boolean_pass_receipt_invalid tests/test_agent_consistency.py::test_completion_audit_marks_missing_pass_field_invalid --tb=short` — 2 passed in 0.60s. `git diff --check -- src/local_ai_hub/agent_consistency.py tests/test_agent_consistency.py` exited 0. Current diff analysis classification exists (`diff_analysis_status`: complete/partial/unavailable); guarded services responses include `analysis_status`. Prior A10/A11 focused validation is separately recorded; no full suite or live runtime claim.
